description: Raw weight that a cooked portion of meat or poultry came from, using the USDA measured cooking yield. Use it to log a cooked portion against raw nutrition data (labels and most databases list raw meat) or to scale a recipe written in cooked weight. Returns raw weight in g, oz, lb and kg, and the raw weight if the yield was at the USDA high or low end.

food.description: Cut and species in plain words, for example "chicken thigh", "80/20 ground beef patty", "ribeye steak", "pork tenderloin", "bacon", "turkey breast", "bison burger".

method.description: Cooking method: roast, grill, braise, simmer, pan_fry, pan_broil, deep_fry, microwave. Plain words work too (grilled, baked, slow cooker, sauteed, boiled).

unit.description: Weight unit: g, kg, oz or lb. Default g.

yield_id.description: Exact row id from find_cooking_yield or list_cooking_yields. Overrides food and method.

name: convert_cooked_to_raw
title: Convert cooked to raw weight
